# Manuscript — excerpt

**Methods:** We conducted a cross-sectional online survey between March and July 2023.

Comparisons between categorical variables used the Fisher exact test, and visual analog scale values were compared by the Mann-Whitney test. Comparisons by age group (40 years or younger versus older than 40 years) were exploratory and were not prespecified.

Of 51 consenting records, 48 completed the sociodemographic module and 31 entered the main module.
